title: Ne'er Misser
summary: +1 hand crossbow deals Force and grants level 3 Magic Missile.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 + 1 Force plus Dexterity. +1 to attack rolls. Martial one-handed ranged weapon, Light, Ammunition, Loading and Dippable, 50 ft.
fields.Magic Missile: Action once per Short Rest. Send 5 darts at targets within 60 ft. Each deals 1d4 + 1 Force with no attack roll or save. Shield negates the darts against its caster.
fields.Piercing Shot: Action, ranged weapon damage. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 or Gaping Wounds for 2 turns. Undead and Constructs are immune. In standard modes hits on the target gain 2 extra Piercing damage. In Honour Mode it takes 2 extra damage of the original type from damage sources. Healing clears the condition. Once per Short Rest with proficiency. Crossbow Expert: Wounding extends Gaping Wounds to 4 turns.
fields.Mobile Shot: After Dash or Disengage on the same turn, make a ranged attack as a Bonus Action within 50 ft. The action lists 1d6 + Dexterity Piercing. Once per Short Rest with proficiency. Dashing more than once in the same round prevents this action.
fields.Acquisition: Buy from Roah Moonglow on Moonrise Towers’ main floor, X −174, Y −179.
fields.Base value: 310 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
